text:
Later this week, the day crew read your second message with care and logged it against the Companion Animal Travel Desk file. You said Buddy's travel was handled badly, that the handoff felt careless, and that you were left carrying the stress while trying to make a connection. That is a fair complaint, and I am sorry the trip put you in that position.

I have checked the desk notes and the service trail. The account shows a breakdown in coordination between the gate team and the animal transfer staff, and that should not have happened. We expect clear, prompt updates when a pet is moving through a skyport, and we expect our people to keep the traveler informed instead of forcing you to chase answers.

<<FACT F120>>

Because the miss affected your onward travel, the file also needs to reflect the connection issue separately. We will review the transfer records, the escort notes, and the baggage-side timing so we can see exactly where the chain failed. If there was a missed connection tied to the handling lapse, the claims team will move that piece through the usual channel once the record is complete.

<<FACT F110>>

I am also asking the local desk to flag this case for service review so the same lapse does not repeat. If you still have supporting notes, photos, or vet paperwork from the trip, send them along and we will add them to the ledger. That helps us keep the record clean and gives the claims team the full picture.

You should not have had to manage this alone, and I am sorry for the trouble it caused. Companion Animal Travel Desk
